title: The Grunion Run, xii
logline: Twelfth year. Five days after 'Lanes.' Wood draws the run and the ridge glow is in the background, small, for the first time on a beach.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. GULLY and MARIA at the thermos. WOOD with the pad. BARNABY, ten, at the surf but not in it. Beyond the bluff, east, faint: the glow.
props: the ridge glow, faint, beyond the bluff

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns and a coffee line, a man with a drawing pad, an old dog at the surf's edge, and faintly beyond the bluff to the east a pale glow on the ridge, muddy watercolor
image.notes: The glow, five days after 'Lanes,' on the beach for the first time. Small.

panels.composition: Maria, handing Wood a cup, looking at the pad.

balloons.text: It's always there. You never drew it.

image.prompt: a practical woman handing a paper cup to a man with a drawing pad and looking at what he's drawn, lantern light

panels.composition: The pad: the run, and the glow, small, on the ridge.

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad showing a lantern-lit beach and a faint glow on a distant ridge

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The lanterns. The dog at the edge. The glow. Nobody looking at it but the reader.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel: silver fish under lanterns, an old dog at the surf's edge, people at a coffee line, and on the ridge beyond a faint glow nobody is looking at, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: Maria notices he's drawn the ridge. 'It's there this year.' The only time anyone remarks on it.
